name: nightlights-dmsp-viirs
title: District-Level Nighttime Lights, DMSP + VIIRS Harmonized (1992–2025)
description: A long district-by-year panel of nighttime lights for 641 Census 2011 districts, 1992-2025, joining the DMSP-OLS and VIIRS satellites. Two published harmonized series side by side: VIIRS converted to the DMSP scale (Li et al. 2020, 1992-2024) and DMSP converted to the VIIRS scale (Chen et al. 2021, Version 2, 1992-2025).

sources.name: Harmonization of DMSP and VIIRS nighttime light data, 1992-2024 (Li, Zhou, Zhao & Zhao 2020, v10)
Global NPP-VIIRS-like nighttime light data, Version 2, 1992-2025 (Chen et al.)
sources.authority: Chen et al., Earth System Science Data 13, 889-906 (2021)

files.description: Panel dataset — 21,794 rows (641 districts x 34 years, 1992-2025) with both harmonized series

attributes.name: district_id
attributes.description: Census 2011 district code (same as the VIIRS nightlights panel)

attributes.name: dmsp_like_source
attributes.description: dmsp (1992-2013, inter-calibrated DMSP) or viirs_converted (2014 on, VIIRS put on the DMSP scale)

attributes.name: dmsp_like_sum
attributes.description: Sum of DMSP-scale digital numbers (0-63) over the district's pixels

attributes.name: dmsp_like_sum_gt7
attributes.description: Sum of digital numbers over pixels above 7, the threshold the source recommends; consistent across the 2013/2014 join

attributes.name: dmsp_like_max
attributes.description: Highest digital number in the district (the top of the scale, 59-63 by satellite, is saturated)

attributes.name: dmsp_like_lit_share_gt7
attributes.description: Share of the district's pixels above digital number 7

attributes.name: dmsp_like_pixels
attributes.description: Number of ~1 km pixels whose centre falls in the district

attributes.name: viirs_like_source
attributes.description: dmsp_reconstructed (1992-2012, modelled from DMSP) or viirs (2013 on)

attributes.name: viirs_like_sum
attributes.description: Sum of VIIRS-like radiance (nW/cm²/sr) over the district's pixels

attributes.name: viirs_like_max
attributes.description: Highest pixel radiance in the district (nW/cm²/sr)

attributes.name: viirs_like_pixels
attributes.description: Number of ~500 m pixels whose centre falls in the district
